products.name: Monstera Deliciosa
products.description: Split, glossy leaves that make one plant feel like a room. Monstera is forgiving — bright indirect light, water when the top inch of soil is dry, and a moss pole once it starts climbing.

products.name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
products.description: The dramatic violin-shaped leaves everyone wants, and the drama to go with them: it dislikes drafts and being moved. Give it a bright spot and leave it there.

products.name: Snake Plant Laurentii
products.description: Stiff, sword-like leaves edged in pale yellow. Survives low light and missed waterings, which makes it the classic first plant and a good bedroom air-freshening pick.

products.name: Pothos Marble Queen
products.description: A trailing vine with cream-and-green marbled leaves. Let it hang from a shelf or climb a stake — it roots easily in water if you want to share cuttings.

products.name: Bird's Nest Fern
products.description: Ruffled, bright-green fronds in a tidy rosette. It loves humidity, so a bathroom with a window or a regular misting keeps the leaf tips crisp.

products.name: Calathea Orbifolia
products.description: Wide, rounded leaves with silver-green stripes that fold up at night. Prefers filtered light and steady moisture — a good choice if you like a plant with a bit of personality.

products.name: ZZ Plant
products.description: Waxy, deep-green leaves on arching stems that shrug off neglect. Stores water in its rhizomes, so it's happiest when you forget to water it.

products.name: Rubber Plant Burgundy
products.description: Thick, burgundy-tinted leaves on an upright stem. Grows tall and bold in a bright corner; wipe the leaves occasionally to keep them glossy.

products.name: String of Pearls
products.description: Bead-like leaves on trailing strands, ideal for a hanging pot. Give it bright light and let the soil dry out fully between waterings.

products.name: Peace Lily
products.description: Dark leaves and white spathes that bloom indoors. It droops visibly when thirsty and perks right back up after watering — an easy plant to read.

products.name: Boston Fern
products.description: Soft, feathery fronds that look best in a hanging basket. Keep the soil evenly moist and out of direct afternoon sun.

products.name: Areca Palm
products.description: Feathery, arching fronds that give a room a tropical feel. Needs bright light and regular watering; a fine choice for a living-room corner.

products.name: Ceramic Vessel — Ash
products.description: A matte ash-grey ceramic planter with a soft glaze and a drainage hole with saucer. Sits well beside plain walls and wooden furniture.

products.name: Stone Planter — Round
products.description: A weighty round planter with a textured stone-look finish. Heavy enough to steady a tall plant and drainage-drilled for healthy roots.

products.name: Terracotta Pot Set of 3
products.description: Three classic terracotta pots in graduated sizes with drainage holes. Porous clay lets roots breathe — pair them up on a sill or step.

products.name: Woven Plant Basket
products.description: A hand-woven basket with a removable liner, made to hold a nursery pot. Adds warmth and texture; use the liner to keep it dry inside.

products.name: Matte Black Cylinder Pot
products.description: A straight-sided matte black cylinder pot with a drainage hole. Clean, modern and easy to style with almost any plant.

products.name: Fluted Ceramic Planter
products.description: Vertical fluting gives this ceramic planter a soft, architectural look. Glazed inside and out, with a drainage hole and saucer.

products.name: Brass Plant Mister
products.description: A small brass-finished mister for humidity-loving plants like ferns and calatheas. Fine spray, sturdy pump, good looking on a shelf.

products.name: Precision Pruning Shears
products.description: Sharp bypass blades for clean cuts on stems up to 15 mm, with a safety lock and a comfortable grip. Clean cuts help plants heal faster.

products.name: Soil Moisture Meter
products.description: Push the probe into the soil for an instant dry-to-wet reading. No battery needed — it takes the guesswork out of watering.

products.name: Watering Can — 1.5L
products.description: A 1.5-litre metal can with a long, slim spout that reaches under leaves and into tight corners without splashing.

products.name: Bamboo Plant Stakes (Set of 6)
products.description: Six natural bamboo stakes (45 cm) to support climbing and top-heavy plants. Tie in gently with garden twine or soft clips.

products.name: Grow Light — Full Spectrum
products.description: A full-spectrum LED grow light on a flexible neck, for dim rooms and winter months. Set on a timer for 8–10 hours a day.

products.name: Money Plant (Golden Pothos)
products.description: The plant found on nearly every Indian windowsill. Trail it from a hanging pot or train it up a stake; it grows happily in soil or in a jar of water.

products.name: Spider Plant
products.description: Arching green-and-white leaves and dangling baby plantlets. Tough, quick to grow and safe around cats and dogs.

products.name: Philodendron (Heartleaf)
products.description: Soft, heart-shaped leaves on a vine that suits a shelf or moss pole. Very forgiving of low light and irregular care.

products.name: Lucky Bamboo (2-layer)
products.description: Twisted two-tier stems that grow in water and small pebbles — no soil, no fuss. Change the water every week or two.

products.name: Bougainvillea
products.description: Papery magenta bracts that cover the plant in bloom. Wants full sun and a lean watering hand, and is a natural for a sunny balcony or fence.

products.name: Hibiscus (Gudhal)
products.description: Large, showy flowers on a glossy-leaved shrub — a fixture of Indian gardens and pooja flowers. Best in strong sun with regular water.

products.name: Jasmine (Mogra)
products.description: Sweetly scented white flowers in the evening. Give it sun, a good pot and regular feeding, and it will scent a whole balcony.

products.name: Rose (Desi Gulab)
products.description: A fragrant, hardy country rose that keeps flowering in pots. Needs at least five hours of sun and a prune after each flush.

products.name: Marigold (Genda)
products.description: Cheerful orange-and-yellow blooms, quick to flower from a nursery pot. Good for festival garlands and for keeping pests off nearby plants.

products.name: Ixora (Rugmini)
products.description: Clusters of small red-orange flowers on a dense evergreen shrub. Loves warm weather, sun and slightly acidic soil.

products.name: Croton (Petra)
products.description: Bold, veined leaves in green, yellow, orange and red. Colours deepen in bright light; keep it out of cold drafts.

products.name: Aloe Vera
products.description: A succulent that does well on a sunny sill or balcony. Water only when the soil is completely dry; the gel is a useful first-aid plant.

products.name: Classic Terracotta Planter (8 in)
products.description: A plain, honest clay pot with a drainage hole. The porous walls let soil dry evenly, which forgives over-watering.

products.name: Ribbed Cement Pot
products.description: Hand-cast cement with vertical ribs and a matte finish that ages gracefully. Heavy and stable, with a drainage hole and rubber feet.

products.name: Hanging Macramé Planter
products.description: A hand-knotted cotton macramé hanger with a ceramic-glazed pot. Hangs from a ceiling hook or curtain rod to free up floor space.

products.name: Self-Watering Planter
products.description: A two-part pot with a hidden water reservoir and a water-level indicator — good for busy weeks and short trips away.

products.name: Balcony Railing Planter
products.description: A long rectangular planter with adjustable hooks that grip a railing. Gives balcony herbs and flowers room without using floor space.

products.name: Organic Potting Mix (5 kg)
products.description: A ready-to-use blend of cocopeat, compost and perlite for pots and planters. Light, well-draining and pre-moistened.

products.name: Vermicompost (2 kg)
products.description: Worm-processed compost that feeds plants slowly and improves soil structure. Mix a handful into the top soil once a month.

products.name: Neem Cake Powder (1 kg)
products.description: Ground neem seed cake — a slow-release feed that also discourages soil pests. Use a spoonful per pot and water in.

products.name: Cocopeat Block (5 kg)
products.description: A compressed coir block that expands into about 25 litres of soft, moisture-holding growing medium. Mix with soil or compost.

products.name: Perlite (1 L)
products.description: Light, porous volcanic glass that keeps potting mixes airy and free-draining. Mix in up to a third by volume for succulents.

products.name: All-purpose Plant Fertiliser (500 g)
products.description: A balanced granular NPK feed for foliage and flowering plants alike. Sprinkle around the plant every two to three weeks in the growing season.

products.name: Gardening Gloves
products.description: Breathable gloves with a nitrile-dipped palm for grip and thorn protection. Machine washable.

products.name: Hand Trowel
products.description: A rust-resistant steel trowel with a rubber-grip handle, sized for repotting and planting out seedlings.

products.name: Wooden Plant Stand
products.description: A tall stand in solid mango wood with a natural oiled finish. Lifts a plant to window height and adds a bit of furniture-grade warmth.

products.name: Metal Plant Stand
products.description: A slim powder-coated iron stand with a round top and three tapered legs. Light to move, sturdy under a full pot.

products.name: Macramé Plant Hanger
products.description: A hand-knotted cotton hanger that fits pots up to 8 inches. Comes with a ceiling hook and a brass ring.

products.name: Decorative Pebbles (1 kg)
products.description: Smooth white river pebbles for topping soil, filling planters or lining a drip tray. They also help hold in moisture.

products.name: Bamboo Planter Stand
products.description: A three-tier bamboo stand that lets you group small pots together. Naturally light and easy to move between rooms.

products.name: Indoor Plant Shelf
products.description: A wall-mounted, two-shelf display in matte-finished wood. Holds a few small pots at eye level without taking up floor space.
